saw_lines: Fragrance is bought by smell, so buyers want a sample before they commit to a full bottle.
So the first ad has to make the smell or the sample offer the reason to click, before the brand story.
Your 30 of 40 listed Google formats are video, so build three Meta video variations from your best Google cut, each opening on the bottle.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 30 of your 40 listed Google formats are video, yet text cannot show a fragrance at all. Build three Meta video variations from your best Google cut, each opening on the bottle.
Your site offers plus 10% off your first order, and a new buyer needs a reason to act today. If your ads do not already lead with it, open three new Meta ads with that 10% first order offer.

We found no proof number on your site, so a first-time buyer weighs only the 10% offer. Add one verified figure, such as a review count, to the top of three new Meta ads and test it against the offer.

Your FAQ already points buyers to discovery sets, the lowest-risk first purchase for fragrance. Build the next ads for Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok and Youtube around a discovery set, so the first buy is a sample, not a full bottle.
